tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a land survey quote request to Roome Land Surveying, a licensed land surveying firm in Plano, Texas, with the details the person gives. Properties in Texas only. Each accepted request emails the person a link to confirm it, and nothing reaches Roome until they do.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The land surveying services Roome Land Surveying offers, each with its slug for request_quote and its page on roomeinc.com.

tools.name: service_area
tools.description: Whether Roome Land Surveying serves a Texas county or city, from the service area on roomeinc.com.

tools.name: which_survey
tools.description: Which of Roome Land Surveying's services fits a person's situation, best match first: the same answers as the chooser on roomeinc.com/services, with why each fits, and each service's common uses and who it's for. Use it when someone doesn't know which survey they need.

tools.name: what_to_expect
tools.description: What happens when you ask Roome Land Surveying for a survey: the quote, how long a survey usually takes, the survey day, and paying. Give a service slug to add what you receive and the steps for that survey.

tools.name: contact_details
tools.description: Roome Land Surveying's phone, office hours, office and mailing addresses, and which email to use for quotes, billing, or anything else.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
